The GT is skid mounted to the extent possible along with all auxiliaries and it is installed inside a structural building. GT train has a power generation output of ~ 58 MW output. The major technical parameters of the HRSG unit is shown in Table 13. Table 13: Technical Details of HRSG Unit Description Parameter Type of HRSG Fired, Single drum, vertical multi-pass, boiler Source of heat Gas turbine exhaust gas & Natural gas supplementary firing Natural gas fired in HRSG 150 - 170 MMBtu/hr The boiler is of the semi-outdoor type cover color coated sheets and designed & constructed according to ASME. The boiler consists of a steam drum, furnace, fuel firing system, super-heater, economizer, air preheater, stack, feed control station, feed water tank, feed water pumps, chemical dosing system, ammonia injection system, Blowdown tanks, air & flue gas duct pipework, electrical system, etc. Condensate return from CCS & DM water make-up is used pre-heated & de-aerated before passing to HRSG. 5.2.3 LP Boilers Two numbers NG fired LP boilers are considered for the project to generate about 800 klb/hr steam at 60 psia for the CCS and WGS island.
